title: 姑娘你非一般人也什么时候你才再立皇后
content_zh:
姑娘，你非一般人也！
唐琳拿上背包，往对面的客栈走过去。街道很宽，这时，一匹快马，从前面飞驰而来，马上之人，对着占路的人群吼叫，“快让开！让开！马不听使唤了！”
人群纷纷一涌而散，但一个三岁小男孩，正站在路中间哭得昏天地暗，“娘！娘！你在哪里呀娘！”
听到小男孩的哭声，唐琳侧身望过去，小男孩很快就要被烈马的蹄子给踩到。
唐琳眸光一沉，异常冷静下来，在那匹马快要踩到小男孩之前，她迅速掏出别在腰间枪套内的手枪，再从另一边的腰部，撩起T恤，衣服内，缠着一排装着化学成分的针筒。她拿了一支，装在手枪上，然后换了个姿势，把枪口对准马的脖子，深作呼吸一下，气息平静后，扳机随即一扣，针筒就被她的手枪给送出去了。
千钧一发之际，烈马被针头刺入，顿时四肢发软，在小男孩面前，瘫痪在地，再也没有力气跑动。
马上的主人，已然在烈马倒下去之际，跳到路边的安全地带。
小男孩的母亲立即跑出来，抱起儿子就离开了。
唐琳走过来，看了一眼四肢发软的马，她径自取下马脖子上的针筒，放回了原位，再把手枪放回腰部的枪套里，转身要走时，马的主人奔上来，拦住了她的去路。这个四十出头的男人，令她的冷眉立即蹙起，“你想干什么？”
张向阳看看已经泄气的烈马，再看向唐琳，脸上，是抑不住的喜悦。想不到，今日出来这么一会，便遇上高手了，还是个个子高挑，画着乞丐脸的二十出头姑娘。“姑娘，在下能否知道，你是如何制服我那烈马的？”
“这个呀……”唐琳弯起迷人的笑意，在张向阳迫不及待想知道答案之际，她的脸色突然冷下，“无可奉告！”转身欲走，可张向阳继续拦截着她的去路，于是不耐烦地瞪向他的眼睛，“你想怎样啊？”
“姑娘，你别生气！”说着，张向阳自怀中取出一张邀请帖，表皮为红色的邀请帖，交到了唐琳手中，“参与大内侍卫选拔的人，有此帖才能进入皇宫，参与选拔。姑娘，你非一般人也，所以在下邀请你去参加大内侍卫选拔赛！”
原本唐琳想立即拒绝的，但一听说是在皇宫内，不禁重新考虑了起来，“你是说，我凭此帖子，能进入皇宫？”云山的根部，就是皇宫，而她在现代消失的地方，就在云山的根部，若是进皇宫找找看，或许能找到时光隧道回去。
张向阳点头，“对的姑娘，凭此可以进入皇宫，参与大内侍卫选拔赛。那在下就不打扰姑娘你了，我们皇宫见！”
唐琳想知道，“什么时候开始选拔？”
张向阳给出正确日期，“下月，初一，地点，皇宫大内侍卫训练基地，凭此帖，有人会指引你找到大内侍卫训练基地的！”
“哦，知道了，”唐琳淡淡应了声，明显对什么选拔赛的，不是很感兴趣，“会不会去，看看情况吧！”
“那行，那在下先告辞了，希望下月初一，能见到姑娘！”说完，张向阳转身而去，嘴角扬起了轻松的笑容。他有本事控制烈马不伤到小男孩，但他故意不这样做，目的就是要引出救小男孩的能人异士来。就不信，不能给主子一位精中之精的侍卫来。
唐琳望了张向阳的背影一眼，没多逗留，拿着邀请帖就去了先前要去的那家客栈。
content_en:
Girl, you are extraordinary!
Tang Lin picked up her backpack and walked to the inn opposite. The street was very wide. At this time, a fast horse galloped from the front. The man on the horse shouted at the crowd occupying the road, "Get out of the way! Get out of the way! The horse is not obeying the command!"
The crowd dispersed one after another, but a three-year-old boy was standing in the middle of the road crying in confusion, "Mother! Mother! Where are you, mother!"
Hearing the little boy's cry, Tang Lin turned sideways and looked over. The little boy was about to be trampled by the hoofs of the fierce horse.
Tang Lin's eyes darkened and she calmed down unusually. Before the horse was about to trample the little boy, she quickly took out the pistol in the holster at her waist, and then lifted up her T-shirt from the other side of her waist. Inside her clothes, there were a row of syringes filled with chemical ingredients. She took one and loaded it on the pistol, then changed her position, pointed the muzzle of the gun at the horse's neck, took a deep breath, and after her breath calmed down, she pulled the trigger and the syringe was ejected by her pistol.
At the critical moment, Lie Ma was pierced by a needle, and his limbs suddenly became weak. In front of the little boy, he fell paralyzed to the ground and no longer had the strength to run.
The owner of the horse had already jumped to a safe area on the side of the road when the fierce horse fell.
The little boy's mother immediately ran out, picked up her son and left.
Tang Lin walked over and took a look at the limp horse. She took off the syringe from the horse's neck and put it back in place. She then put the pistol back into the holster on her waist. When she turned to leave, the horse's owner ran up and blocked her way. This man in his early forties made her frown immediately, "What do you want to do?"
Zhang Xiangyang looked at the deflated Liima, then looked at Tang Lin, with uncontrollable joy on his face. Unexpectedly, after being out for a while today, I met a master, a tall girl in her early twenties with a beggar's face. "Girl, do you know how you subdued my fierce horse?"
"Well..." Tang Lin smiled charmingly. When Zhang Xiangyang couldn't wait to know the answer, her face suddenly turned cold. "No comment!" She turned around to leave, but Zhang Xiangyang continued to block her way, so she stared into his eyes impatiently, "What do you want?"
"Girl, don't be angry!" As he spoke, Zhang Xiangyang took out an invitation card with a red cover and handed it to Tang Lin. "Those who participate in the Ouchi Guard Selection can only enter the palace and participate in the selection if they have this invitation. Girl, you are not an ordinary person, so I invite you to participate in the Ouchi Guard Selection!"
Tang Lin originally wanted to refuse immediately, but when she heard that it was in the palace, she couldn't help but reconsider, "You mean, I can enter the palace with this post?" The root of Yunshan is the palace, and the place where she disappeared in modern times is at the root of Yunshan. If she goes into the palace and searches, maybe she can find a time tunnel to go back.
Zhang Xiangyang nodded, "That's right, girl. With this, you can enter the palace and participate in the imperial guard selection competition. Then I won't disturb you, girl. We'll see you in the palace!"
Tang Lin wanted to know, "When will the selection start?"
Zhang Xiangyang gave the correct date, "Next month, the first day of the lunar month, the location is the Imperial Palace Guards Training Base. With this post, someone will guide you to the Ouchi Guards Training Base!"
"Oh, I understand," Tang Lin responded lightly, obviously not very interested in the selection competition, "Will you go? Let's see how it goes!"
"Okay, I'll take my leave now. I hope I can see the girl on the first day of next month!" After saying that, Zhang Xiangyang turned around and left with a relaxed smile on his lips. He had the ability to control the powerful horse so as not to hurt the little boy, but he deliberately did not do so in order to lure out capable people and strangers who could save the little boy. I don’t believe that I can’t give my master a bodyguard who is the best among the best.
Tang Lin glanced at Zhang Xiangyang's back, didn't stay long, took the invitation and went to the house she was going to.Inn.
